rows.requirement: Eligibility predicates, condition relations, and seeded deterministic selection
rows.packEvidence: Generated query: records.data.executionReadiness.clauses[].engineHooks[].engine == engine:F1; rule and item inventories identify eligibility/selection hooks.
rows.codeEvidence: Condition relations and seeded selection primitives exist; the clause-wide provider-neutral execution contract is not yet certified.
rows.notes: Family owner is the existing Engine F1 epic; exact membership is deliberately query-derived.

rows.requirement: Activation and action-economy budgets, including legendary-action allowance and per-option cost
rows.packEvidence: Generated query finds engine:F2 hooks in records.data.executionReadiness; the projected mechanics do not contain a legendary-action budget for every source clause.
rows.codeEvidence: packages/core/src/state/actionEconomy.ts models legendaryActionAllowance, usage, turn-window legality, and option costs.
rows.notes: Non-pack-only proof row: the legendary budget requirement is revealed by source/audit/code, not by projected mechanics alone.

rows.requirement: Concentration, active effects, duration termination, and controlled-entity lifecycle
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; creature and magic-item inventories identify concentration and entity-lifecycle clauses.
rows.codeEvidence: Active-effect and concentration state modules exist, but cross-record lifecycle conformance remains an engine capability requirement.
rows.notes: Includes summon/revert/termination timing where the source clause makes it executable.

rows.requirement: Canonical spell execution with caster-of-record, slot gate, and upcast semantics
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; the audit names shallow spell procedures and higher-level alternatives.
rows.codeEvidence: Spell-slot and spellcasting derivation code exists; canonical caster/tool execution is not a complete reference-engine contract.
rows.notes: The owner is the existing Engine F4 family epic, not the historically same-numbered 2n1t bead.

rows.requirement: Item-instance use, charges, cooldowns, attunement, curse, and persistent state
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; magic-item inventory separates usage economies from persistent state and attunement.
rows.codeEvidence: magicItemMechanics.ts, item state, custody, attunement, and usage-counter paths implement substantial primitives.
rows.notes: Exact clause ownership must be generated from the clause-complete corpus later.

rows.requirement: Hit points, healing, temporary HP, conditions, curses, death, dying, and suffocation lifecycle
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; amended audit findings include ongoing damage and half-damage branches that require lifecycle state.
rows.codeEvidence: HP, condition, death/dying, and temporary-HP state paths exist; complete clause-driven conformance is still owned by this family.
rows.notes: Suffocation and recurring damage are included as lifecycle requirements when their source clauses are deterministic.

rows.requirement: Rest, elapsed time, duration counters, reset orchestration, and planar-return clocks
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; rule and magic-item inventories identify dawn, rest, duration, and cooldown triggers.
rows.codeEvidence: Clock, rest, timer, and reset orchestration primitives exist but require clause-level reference-engine coverage.
rows.notes: Reset triggers are represented as semantic procedures, not copied totals.

rows.requirement: Checks, saves, attacks, DCs, proficiency, and derived modifiers
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; multi-save entries and save-dependent outcomes are explicit amended audit gaps.
rows.codeEvidence: Dice, checks, saves, attack resolution, and character-derived modifiers exist, with multi-save and source-qualifier coverage still required.
rows.notes: The requirement is the full structured outcome, not merely presence of a DC field.

rows.requirement: Geometry, targeting, point-origin areas, damage alternatives, riders, half-damage branches, movement, contests, and object interaction
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; current inventories identify geometry and derived-math hooks but not every source branch.
rows.codeEvidence: Dice and derived math exist; complete geometry, rider, alternative, and object-damage execution is not certified.
rows.notes: Missing-source examples include point-origin geometry, rider damage, half-damage success branches, and pit variants.

rows.requirement: Downtime, currency, inventory, XP, property, and deterministic asset creation
rows.packEvidence: Generated query over data.executionReadiness engineHooks; the 2026-07-06 boundary inventory routes economy and asset procedures to F10.
rows.codeEvidence: Currency and character progression modules exist; a DM-facing canonical tool surface and complete asset procedure remain capability work.
rows.notes: Includes equipment/property arithmetic only where a source clause requires deterministic mutation.
